title: The Straight Darkness
working_title: History Before Time: The Straight Darkness
logline: Twenty-four chambers carved straight out of solid rock with no quarry debris and no paper trail — and Jakobus, who always asks what a made thing is for, finds a wonder that refuses even its maker.
blueprint: Jakobus-led wonder-of-place — the Longyou Grottoes anomaly (Crichton-grade engineering, zero historical record); grounded not woo; Jakobus's made-thing read load-bearing
market: literary travel-adventure — the China site the brochure hasn't learned to sell yet
